title: On Bitopological Lie Groupoids
content: We introduce and study a framework for Lie groupoids equipped with two smooth man- ifold structures on their spaces of objects and arrows. The associated topologies are allowed to dier, and the groupoid structure maps are required to satisfy appropriate smoothness conditions with respect to both structures. We formulate the basic definitions of bitopological manifolds, bitopological Lie groupoids, and morphisms between them. We investigate the relationship between the two topologies, the behavior of units and inverses, and the construction of the Lie algebroid associated with a bitopological Lie groupoid. Several examples are presented, including ordinary Lie groupoids, pair groupoids, and action groupoids. We also discuss restrictions, pullbacks, and compatibility conditions for the two induced Lie algebroid structures. The purpose of this paper is to provide a common framework for studying Lie groupoid structures in which two distinct topological or smooth structures play simultaneous roles.
